description: This file provides functions for encoding and decoding access tokens, and extracting tokens from HTTP Authorization headers. It includes simple token issuance for demo purposes and utility functions for handling Base64 URL-safe encoding and decoding.

methods.name: str _b64url_encode(data: bytes)
methods.description: Encodes bytes into a URL-safe Base64 string without padding.

methods.name: bytes _b64url_decode(data: str)
methods.description: Decodes a URL-safe Base64 string (without padding) into bytes.

methods.name: str issue_access_token(*, user_id: str, role: str, email: str)
methods.description: Creates a demo, unsigned access token with user info.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] decode_access_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates a demo access token, raises HTTPException if invalid.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_token_from_authorization_header(auth_header: Optional[str])
methods.description: Extracts Bearer token from HTTP Authorization header.

ctags.name: issue_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def issue_access_token(*, user_id: str, role: str, email: str) -> str:$/
ctags.signature: (*, user_id: str, role: str, email: str)
